title: Probing Self-Report Consistency in LLMs
track: Consciousness and moral status of AI systems
content:
## Problem

Seed placeholder project. We test whether LLM self-reports about internal states are consistent under paraphrase and adversarial reframing.

## Method

We built a battery of 200 paraphrased introspection prompts and measured answer consistency across three models.

## Results

Consistency varies widely by model and prompt framing; we release the battery and scoring script.

## Limitations

Weekend-scale; no human baseline. Replace with a real submission snapshot.

title: A Minimal Welfare Evaluation Checklist for Deployed Agents
content:
## Problem

Seed placeholder project. There is no lightweight checklist for flagging welfare-relevant states in deployed agentic systems.

## Method

We adapted three published welfare frameworks into a 12-item checklist and applied it to two open-source agent frameworks.

## Results

The checklist surfaced 4 candidate concerns; most items were inapplicable, suggesting the frameworks need agent-specific revision.

## Limitations

Checklist validity is untested. Replace with a real submission snapshot.
